About NAIZON

Website Development & Digital Solutions for Businesses

NAIZON is a website development and digital solutions company providing website design, custom web development, ecommerce development, mobile app development and related digital services for businesses.

What does NAIZON do?

We turn practical requirements into working digital products.

NAIZON plans, designs and develops responsive websites, custom web applications, ecommerce experiences and mobile applications. The work can include UI/UX design, frontend development, backend services, API integration, testing, launch and agreed ongoing support.

Services are intended for businesses and individuals that need a clearer web presence, a customer-facing digital experience or a practical application supporting a real workflow.

Approach

How does NAIZON develop digital products?

The process starts by understanding the audience, requirement and desired outcome. NAIZON then defines scope, plans the structure and technical approach, designs and builds the product, tests agreed journeys and supports launch.

The approach favours clear communication, responsive design, maintainable implementation and no added complexity unless it solves a real problem.

Capabilities

What technologies does NAIZON use?

NAIZON works with React, Vite, modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, REST APIs, Supabase, Android and cross-platform approaches. Unity and C# are used for the game development work shown on the website.

Technology is selected according to project requirements, integrations and maintenance needs rather than forcing every project into one stack.
